summary: Round 1, from scratch. Control (incumbent recipe) at 151M: 9/9 greedy episodes slide down the start ramp at ~1,130 u/s into kill sheet *18 (z 160) at 4.4 s, 5.7% - the north-slide family of traps, not the pit. Go-Explore with the pbf flags (15 min, 631k cells) never leaves the pit: chains reach the pit floor ~800 u of energy height below the record. Cause found: uniform keys under --view-follow wish backward half the time = a 250 u/s/tick air brake; new explore_phase1 --view-follow-nobrake (commit 19ae2856, tested bit-identical off) is searching now. Next: if it finds a pit exit, a backward curriculum on that line from scratch.
